# Meridian Marine Co. — Vendor Qualification & Performance v1

## Qualification

Before routine assignment, evaluate where appropriate:

- Relevant capability
- Experience
- Coverage area
- Availability
- Emergency response capability
- Insurance/credentials where relevant
- References or prior performance
- Commercial fit

## Performance measures

Track:

- Response time
- Arrival reliability
- Completion reliability
- Scope adherence
- Communication quality
- Evidence/documentation quality
- Cost accuracy
- Client impact
- Repeat failures

## Vendor status review

Performance may result in:

- Preferred
- Approved Backup
- Conditional
- Restricted

## Failure response

A material vendor failure should result in immediate client/vessel protection first, then review of whether the vendor remains appropriate for future work.

## Continuous review

Vendor performance should be reviewed periodically and after material failures rather than only during initial onboarding.
